info.title: MavaPOS Partner API
info.description: Read-only merchant reporting using dedicated bearer API keys. 60 requests/minute/key. Integer IDR, ISO8601 Asia/Makassar timestamps. Date ranges are half-open [from,to), max 31 days. Sandbox fixtures use outlet 900001 and sale date 2026-11-13. Webhooks are transaction.created only; signed with HMAC SHA256(timestamp + "." + raw_body), at most five delivery attempts. See partner-api.md for deployment, key issuance and receiver verification.

servers.description: Replace domain with deployed backend; live key required.
